title: Undoing Mistakes Safely (restore, reset, revert)
introduction: Every developer makes mistakes — staging the wrong file, deleting code accidentally, or making a commit with bugs. Today you learn Git's safety net: how to unstage files with `restore`, fix the last commit with `--amend`, and understand the crucial difference between `reset` and `revert`.
why_it_matters: Knowing how to undo mistakes calmly prevents panic and lost work. It gives you the confidence to experiment freely knowing that Git can always bring your project back to safety.
practical_activity_preview: Unstage a file, discard unstaged edits, amend a commit message, and create a safe revert commit.
